verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documentation of per-tool-call or per-connection pricing, nor any rate-limit specifications; the only pricing reference (glama-docs-10) merely mentions workflow automation, not cost structure. Community reports (glama-comm-2, glama-comm-3) describe an undocumented credit-card requirement blocking rebuilds, directly undermining any claim of pricing/billing transparency, but since no first-party transparent-pricing claim exists in the pack, this is best classified as an unmet axis rather than a dispute.
